title: Under-deck vertical TMD at midspan on clamped cross-frame with perforated screen
problem_restatement: Lively 1.9 Hz vertical footbridge mode exceeds 0.7 m/s2 comfort limit and needs under-deck retrofit hung entirely from below with no deck closure or appearance change that dissipates mode energy to comfortable acceleration
mechanism_sentence: A hidden 800 kg weight on soft springs and dampers under the middle of the bridge moves opposite to the deck to soak up the 1.9 Hz bounce and hold shaking near 0.11 m/s2 below the 0.7 m/s2 comfort limit.
decisive_choices: Tune 800 kg mass to 1.83 Hz with 12% damping at 4% mass ratio to cut 1.75 m/s2 bare to 0.106 m/s2 damped
Hang entire unit from girder bottom flanges on 8 friction clamps for 3.26 slip factor with no drilling and install from below
Recess unit in under-deck cassette behind color-matched perforated screen with plus-minus 30 mm stroke clearance and lock-off pin
open_question: What are the existing girder bottom-flange thickness, clamp spacing and local bending stress under about 1.23 kN per clamp plus under 0.40 kN dynamic to close the flange-bending check?
transfer_line: Energy: girders -> support frame -> moving mass | Measured: deck acceleration -> accelerometer

assumed_constraints.constraint: Comfort target is peak vertical deck acceleration below 0.7 m/s2, max-comfort band, 1.9 Hz in critical 1.25-2.3 Hz range requiring check
Modal mass 20000 kg assumed for Den Hartog sizing with 4% mass ratio
Bare steel damping near 0.4 percent of critical
Added mass carried from existing girders entirely from below deck with no deck closure or deck appearance change

functional_decomposition: Dissipate first vertical mode energy at 1.9 Hz to comfortable acceleration
Carry added damper mass from existing girders entirely from below deck with no deck closure or deck appearance change, and allow lock-off and inspection
Preserve deck appearance from eye-height with no visible change to parapet, floor or sightlines

concept.working_principle: Moving mass on coil springs plus viscous damper tuned to 1.83 Hz moves out of phase with 1.9 Hz deck mode to dissipate energy, hung from girder bottom flanges at midspan with no deck appearance change

parts.name: Existing longitudinal girder
parts.function: Carry deck and provide bottom-flange support

parts.name: Transverse cross-beam
parts.function: Span between girders to carry TMD unit

parts.name: Friction beam clamps
parts.function: Clamp cross-beam to girder bottom flanges without drilling

parts.name: Bolted under-deck support frame
parts.function: Hold springs, damper and moving mass below deck

parts.name: TMD moving mass
parts.function: Move out of phase to absorb 1.9 Hz mode energy

parts.name: Coil spring set
parts.function: Provide vertical stiffness tuned to 1.83 Hz

parts.name: Perforated soffit screen
parts.function: Hide cassette with shadow gap, no deck change

key_estimates.quantity: peak vertical deck acceleration comfort limit
damped peak deck acceleration with TMD
total static hung load TMD plus frame

fabrication_steps.description: Clamp cross-beam to girder bottom flanges from mobile lift below with no drilling
Bolt support frame cassette to cross-beam and fit lock-off pin
Mount coil springs plus viscous damper plus 800 kg mass free only vertically with plus-minus 30 mm clearance
Fit shadow-gap perforated color-matched soffit screen below frame with zero deck change

risks.risk: Modal mass differs from assumed 20000 kg causing detuning
risks.mitigation: Freeze modal mass at 20000 kg and rerun Den Hartog sizing with measured mass

risks.risk: Clamp slip under hung TMD load
risks.mitigation: Share 9.81 kN hung load on 8 clamps for 32.0 kN capacity and 3.26 factor

risks.risk: Local girder flange bending under clamp point loads
risks.mitigation: Treat about 1.23 kN per clamp as person-scale non-critical at concept stage and do detailed check with flange thickness and spacing

novelty_claim: Recessed under-deck TMD cassette with shadow-gap perforated color-matched screen hiding tuned unit on clamped no-drill support with lock-off
